name: search_memory
description: ⚡ PRIORITY TOOL - CHECK FIRST! KEYWORD/ENTITY SEARCH in persistent MEMORY DATABASE using FTS5 with BM25 ranking. This searches the MEMORY DB (key-value pairs the user saved), NOT files on disk. USE THIS BEFORE action tools when user asks about anything they might have previously configured, set up, or told you about. Searches stored information by entity names, keywords, or technical terms. Examples: 'what is my favorite food', 'server password', 'project location'. ALWAYS try this first before execute_bash, query_service_logs, or api_call. For conceptual/meaning-based questions, use semantic_recall instead. FOR VERIFICATION: After searching, explicitly report whether matching entries were found. IMPORTANT: If no results, try semantic_recall as fallback. NOTE: For FILES in jarvis-intel folder, use manage_intel with action=list instead.

query.description: Search term to find in stored memories
